def solve(xs: list[int]) -> int:
    """Return the length of the longest run of consecutive elements
    that all share the same parity (all even or all odd).

    A single element counts as a run of length 1. An empty input
    has no runs, so it returns 0.
    """
    if not xs:
        return 0
    best = 1
    cur = 1
    prev_parity = xs[0] % 2
    for x in xs[1:]:
        parity = x % 2
        if parity == prev_parity:
            cur += 1
        else:
            cur = 1
            prev_parity = parity
        if cur > best:
            best = cur
    return best
